digest.component_or_area: review-bot deployment and persistent tickets clone management
propositions: The AWS review-bot's persistent EBS-backed tickets clone diverges across redeploys because the Docker entrypoint clones only when .git is absent, and reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh does not fetch or reset divergent history.

The ensure script must converge the clone by fetching with explicit refspec +refs/heads/tickets:refs/remotes/origin/tickets, then delegating compatible states to rebar._store.sync.reconverge while preserving local-only commits.

A narrow pre-epoch adoption path must reset the clone to a pinned fetched commit only when the local tip is pre-epoch, the remote has a valid epoch, the prior remote was readable, and the local tip is an ancestor of the prior remote—otherwise preserve the local tip and warn.
The autodeploy.sh BOT_PATHS omits reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh, preventing ensure-script changes from triggering redeploy; this must be fixed so future script changes self-deploy.
Convergence must remain best-effort outside the PAT block and must never undo or wedge an already-cast Gerrit vote, preserving safety through the existing artifact-emit error handler.
A failed or credentialless fetch must exit success, preserve the local tip exactly, and emit an operator-readable warning to prevent set -eu from aborting a vote.
